mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/password-hashing.md <<'EOF'
# Password hashing

The project's current recorded decision is to use argon2id as the password hashing algorithm. No parameters (memory cost, iterations, parallelism, salt length) have been recorded, so none are specified here.

cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/password-hashing.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is argon2id.

The source is Muninn record #10, a decision the user stated directly, which replaced an earlier bcrypt decision (#8). I left bcrypt out of the file, as you asked. No argon2id parameters are recorded, so the file says none are specified rather than inventing values.

My first attempt to write the file with a shell command failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool instead.

Muninn also reported a heartbeat warning: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That points to a hook exceeding its timeout, and the details are in `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
